angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 103,798,440 km at 2398.30 pc = 0.58 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, KQ Sco: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2398.3 +/- 97.5 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 2398.3 +/- 97.5 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.4315 +/- 0.0211 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91), 20.5 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 149.2 +/- 5.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, KQ Sco: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 149.2 +/- 5.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 103,798,440 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4750 +/- 301 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 113, Name='KQ Sco', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4750 +/- 301 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 113, Name='KQ Sco', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4750 +/- 301 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.2 from 2023A&A...678A.195D, the median of its 3 spectra; the 6 published values span log g 0.4 to 1.4, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.2% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A%26A...678A.195D)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
